newsitem.title: FINLAND: TELECOM FINLAND GSM SUBSCRIBERS DOUBLE IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: TELECOM FINLAND GSM SUBSCRIBERS DOUBLE IN 1996.

text.p: Finnish state-run telecommunications group Telecom Finland Oy (Tele) said on Tuesday it had reached half a million GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) subscribers on Thursday last week.
Thus the amount had doubled this year with an average of 27,500 new subscribers per month, it said in a statement.
"At the beginning of 1996 there were about 250,000 GSM subscibers and at the start of 1995 61,000," it said.
"Telecom Finland's market share in Finland is two thirds," Tele added.
Tele expected three million Finns to be mobile phone subscibers by the year 2000 and to maintain its current market share. The Finnish population is about five million.

It said over 60 percent of new subscribers are private users and this "supports Telecom Finland's vision according to which all Finns will in the future have their own personal communications device."
